periods.label: 解放军使徒微笑

status.injuries: both hands severed by Ikki before later medical treatment possible

appearance.overview: Man with facial tattoos wearing Rebellion apostle clothing.

attire.default: black coat with gold embroidery identifying a Rebellion Apostle
attire.combat: paired Judgment Ring Devices on both middle fingers

distinctive: distorted smile due to facial tattoos

personality.summary: Sadistic, theatrical and manipulative; delights in punishment and humiliation.
flaws: relies on knowing opponents will protect innocents
personality.inner_conflict: None shown; his ideology rationalizes cruelty.

decision_pattern.combat: provokes opponents into attacking so Judgment Ring can absorb and return force

quote_samples: 有罪就该罚，惩罚即是赦免。

mannerisms: uses hostage threats to force moral choices

background.pre_story: Leads a Rebellion cell that raids public facilities for money and goods.

relationships.stella-vermillion: Attempts to humiliate her after exploiting her compassion.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: Defeated by Ikki's unseen sword strike.

periods.summary: Smile leads the Rebellion group that seizes the mall. He captures hostages, exploits a child's mistake to bait Stella, uses Judgment Ring to absorb her attack and force her into public humiliation, but is neutralized when Shizuku's barrier protects the hostages and Ikki cuts off both ring-bearing hands.

key_events.summary: Commands the hostage-taking, humiliates Stella, and is defeated by Ikki.
